change_scope: CandidateFeasibilityCompiler validates candidate 001, the authoritative compiled replay, before materializing candidates 002 onward. The full deterministic sequence is generated unchanged when replay fails.
semantic_invariants: Candidate 001 bytes and gate context are unchanged.
The same hard gates decide acceptance.
If candidate 001 passes, the pre-existing implementation also selected it as passing[0].
If candidate 001 fails, candidates 002 onward are generated with the original inputs, ordering, seeds, and gate logic.
No topology, area, budget, qualification, or patient threshold changes.
